articles.title: Here is how Coinbase plan to survive the crypto downturn by ditching its reliance on trading fees
articles.snippet: Analysts say the exchange's push into derivatives, payments and infrastructure broadens its growth story beyond crypto trading.

articles.title: A new Bittensor proposal would turn validators into something like fund managers
articles.snippet: Root Reborn would have TAO validators pick which subnets to back and reinvest yield into, rather than constantly selling subnet tokens to pay stakers. It is a code proposal in review, not a live change.

articles.title: BitGo offers Europe’s crypto firms a MiCA-compliance lifeline as license deadline looms
articles.snippet: BaFin-regulated BitGo says its Crypto-as-a-Service platform can help eligible crypto players across Europe with an alternative way to navigate MiCA.

articles.title: Blockchain.com deepens onchain stock offerings as tokenized equities market grows
articles.snippet: The rollout in collaboration with Ondo Finance broadens access to tokenized traditional assets as demand for onchain stocks and ETFs continues to grow.

articles.title: Bybit lands on Singapore MAS Investor Alert List
articles.snippet: Crypto exchange Bybit has been added to Singapore’s MAS Investor Alert List, which flags entities that may be mistakenly perceived as licensed or regulated.
